thesis: The page is a thermal receipt: every section prints a line item onto a paper strip with a torn bottom edge, and the signature is the running tally that accumulates as you scroll toward the form.

signature.name: Running Receipt
signature.summary: A vertical thermal-paper strip with dashed left border and jagged torn bottom edge; each section ends with a receipt line that wipes in on scroll via --sw-p. Reused in hero header, quote builder live tally, proof review notes, checklist explorer slips, and footer thank-you line.

motion.intro: Receipt strip slides up; three header lines type in sequentially (1.1s, skippable). Marquee fades in.
stories: Quote builder selections print receipt lines via clip-path wipe
Checklist items stack in as receipt lines with stagger
motion.hover: Receipt lines grow sienna underline from left via scaleX
